text:
Marla: Quick sync: we need to finalise autoscale and burst billing behavior for the next Dedicated pilot. Two open asks from sales: (1) deterministic eviction order for predictable SLAs, (2) a simple carryover rule for unused burst credits. Thoughts?
Ben: Eviction order: keep pinned/guaranteed sessions last. Then best-effort streams, then background tasks. Emit eviction_reason codes in telemetry.
Ivy: Carryover suggestion: allow up to 20% carryover month->month, single-step only. Show carryover on console and in billing export.
Sourav: Autoscale policy: avoid aggressive spin-ups. Proposal: target_util 0.68, predictive lookahead 3m, and a slow-scale cap of +25% infra per 5m window. Also add model-variant fallback if scale slower.
Marla: Acceptance checklist draft: deterministic eviction + reason codes, carryover line item in billing, console visibility, predictive scaler with fallback, pilot runbook.
ops-bot: Deploy queued: rollout/dedicated/pilot-config -> staging at 1771234579 :wrench:
Ben: I'll own eviction_reason enum and telemetry. ETA 8d.
Ivy: I'll mock console carryover view and API. ETA 5d.
Sourav: I'll prototype scaler knobs and a fallback routing flag. ETA 3 sprints.
Marla: Thanks team I'll compile PRD and share with customers by EOD.
